% A document with titletoc's partial table of contents, list of figures,
% and list of tables, and algorithm's list, beside those lists of an
% earlier build and the .aux of a later build that used none of these
% packages, so the .aux names none of the lists. titletoc reads
% its partial lists with \@input when it prints them. The .ptc comes
% from a build that loaded xcolor: it has an entry with \textcolor, and
% xcolor is not loaded here. Each other list holds an \addtocontents
% write of \oldmark, which this document does not define, after
% titletoc's \ttl@starttoc in its own files. The .plf also has a line of
% text written with \addtocontents, so only its extension shows it is a
% list. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\usepackage{algorithm}
\begin{document}
\listofalgorithms
\section{First}
\startcontents
\printcontents{}{1}{}
\startlist{lof}
\printlist{lof}{}{}
\startlist{lot}
\printlist{lot}{}{}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{New subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\begin{algorithm}[h]
An algorithm.
\caption{New algorithm}
\end{algorithm}
\end{document}
